status: Native-package deterministic regression protocol, not a cluster benchmark
scope: Actual handleCreateNetpol, processResults, normalization, quantiles and threshold implementation. HTTP test server substitutes proxy; synthetic unstructured Kubernetes objects substitute informer delivery.
cases: Unique/same policy names crossed with first-policy delay 1000/6000ms. Second-policy delay always 1000ms. Creation times 1000/9000ms.
threshold: Ready Max > 5000ms must fail. This is a deterministic regression boundary, not an estimated production SLO.
expected_problem: Same-name timestamp overwrite makes first-policy delay -2000ms in the slow case and merges two metrics. Maximum 1000ms passes despite true maximum 6000ms.
fix_baseline: Use namespace/name consistently for creation timestamps, connection attribution and metric grouping.
acceptance: Unmodified native code reproduces false pass; patched code rejects slow cases and accepts fast controls; two distinct policies remain separate.
limits: No actual CNI, Kubernetes API server, proxy deployment, or production failure. Straightforward identity fix is not journal novelty.
